name: Klenty
description_en:
Klenty combines multichannel cadences, CRM integration and calling/coaching tools for SDR teams. Its current site distinguishes Sales Engagement from a Dialer Suite and regional dialers. Power dialing calls a list sequentially; parallel dialing attempts multiple lines. Do not assume every dialer or coaching function is part of the lowest engagement subscription. Performance figures on the site were not tested here.

A pilot can import a small CSV, map name/email/company fields, build email and task steps, and confirm completed activity reaches the CRM. The API introduction requires an API key from Settings → Integrations → Klenty API Key, uses JSON and distinguishes GET reads from POST actions. It also states a prospect belongs to one list, while tags provide another organizing method. Check these semantics before reproducing a multi-list segmentation model.
description_zh:
Klenty 为 SDR 团队组合多渠道节奏、CRM 集成与通话／辅导工具。当前官网区分 Sales Engagement、Dialer Suite 与地区拨号产品。Power dialing 顺序拨打名单，parallel dialing 同时尝试多条线路。不能假定最低跟进套餐包括所有拨号与辅导功能，官网表现数字也未经本次实测。

试点可导入小型 CSV，映射姓名、邮箱、公司，构建邮件与任务步骤，再确认已完成活动写回 CRM。API 入门说明需从 Settings → Integrations → Klenty API Key 取得密钥，使用 JSON，并区分 GET 读取与 POST 动作。文档还说明一条线索只属于一个列表，标签提供另一种组织方法；迁移多列表分组模型前应先核对这些语义。

The API introduction requires an API key from Settings → Integrations → Klenty API Key, uses JSON and distinguishes GET reads from POST actions. It also states a prospect belongs to one list, while tags provide another organizing method. Check these semantics before reproducing a multi-list segmentation model.
steps.zh: 试点可导入小型 CSV，映射姓名、邮箱、公司，构建邮件与任务步骤，再确认已完成活动写回 CRM。API 入门说明需从 Settings → Integrations → Klenty API Key 取得密钥，使用 JSON，并区分 GET 读取与 POST 动作。文档还说明一条线索只属于一个列表，标签提供另一种组织方法；迁移多列表分组模型前应先核对这些语义。

items.en: Growth documents bidirectional field mapping, CRM list import/export and activity actions. Use a changed test record to check mapping and ownership before bulk enrollment; if a request fails, inspect existing destination data before repeating a POST. Calling minutes, numbers, regional availability and dialer add-ons need a purchase-specific quote. Klenty suits coordinated SDR operations; it may be excessive for a single fixed email reminder. The public service is hosted; source licensing and self-hosting were not verified.
items.zh: Growth 文档列出双向字段映射、CRM 列表导入导出与活动动作。批量入序前应用变更的测试记录核对映射及归属；请求失败时先检查目标数据，再重复 POST。通话分钟、号码、地区与拨号附加项需按采购场景报价。Klenty 适合协调 SDR 运营，单一邮件提醒可能用不到这些功能。公开服务为托管形式，未确认源代码许可或自托管。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The annual pricing view shows Starter $50/month with unlimited users/mailboxes and limits of 15,000 monthly contacts and 75,000 emails. Growth is $70/user/month and Plus $99/user/month, billed annually; parallel/power dialer is advertised as a $45/user/month add-on. The trial FAQ permits fourteen days and up to 200 emails; without upgrading the account is deactivated. This specific cap qualifies the broader homepage claim of unrestricted trial access.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年付定价展示 Starter 每月 50 美元，用户与邮箱不限，但每月联系人为 15,000、邮件 75,000。Growth 每用户月价 70 美元，Plus 99，均年付；parallel/power dialer 作为每用户每月 45 美元附加项。试用 FAQ 说明十四天、最多发送 200 封，不升级则账户停用。这个明确上限限定了首页“无限制试用”的宽泛说法。
